summary: Full frontend E2E testing of the Digital Anamnesis multilingual offline prototype. Ran an 11-step Playwright flow covering: landing DE/EN + persistence, profile validation, 8-section questionnaire (all field types: text/number/textarea/select/radio/checkboxes/slider), conditional fields (allergyDetails, medicationDetails, operationDetails), required-field validation (mainComplaint), autosave + mid-questionnaire reload, Continue-saved-anamnesis button on landing, Review page (profile + 8 section cards + edit-section jump-back), Summary page (Print, Download JSON blob, Share mock toast), and Start-over confirm dialog with localStorage cleanup. All 11 core scenarios PASSED. No backend to test.

issues: Uses native browser <input type=date> picker instead of a shadcn calendar component. Acceptable for a prototype and accessible, but flagged per general guideline.

critical_code_review_comments: useLocalStorage.js writes to localStorage on every value change via useEffect - fine for this small prototype but note that setData is called from context on every keystroke, causing a serialize+write per keystroke. Consider debouncing if the app grows.

AnamnesisContext.reset() calls removeData() then setData(emptyState) - the useEffect in useLocalStorage will immediately re-persist the empty state; this is intended (empty seed) but means localStorage is never truly absent after the first mount. hasSavedData correctly returns false when profile/answers are empty, so behavior is correct.

Review page profile 'Row' component uses `empty={!p.firstName}` etc but relation row is always shown as a value (never empty). Minor: relation could still be `self` even if user cleared it; not a real issue.
Questionnaire.jsx: navigating via edit-section sets currentStep in context, then Questionnaire re-mounts and initializes local step from data.currentStep - works correctly. Verified.

No accessibility labels aria-* on custom radio-card / checkbox-card buttons (they are <button>s with visible labels which is acceptable but adding role='radio'/role='checkbox' + aria-checked would be nicer for screen readers).
test_credentials: None - no auth, all data in browser localStorage
seed_data_creation: None persisted; each test run clears localStorage before starting
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only React prototype at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Uses localStorage keys anamnesis.lang and anamnesis.data. Key data-testids: start-button, continue-button, lang-btn-de/en, profile-first-name/last-name/dob, profile-next-button, relation-<self|child|parent|other>, error-first-name, error-dob, next-button, back-button, section-title, progress-bar, field-<name>-input/-textarea/-select/-slider, field-<name>-option-<value>, field-<name>-error, review-section-<id>, edit-section-<id>, submit-button, print-button, download-button, share-mock-button, start-over-button, confirm-delete-dialog, confirm-delete-confirm, confirm-delete-cancel, header-home-button. Review/Summary pages animate in via framer-motion; always wait ~800ms after navigation before querying selectors. The 'Send to practice' button is intentionally a MOCKED toast (marked as such in the app).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. Two false negatives observed during the first test pass (review-section-personalBasics card=false and summary buttons queries returning null) were due to timing (framer-motion enter animation) - a follow-up run with 1.5s wait confirmed all elements render correctly. Recommend adding `await page.wait_for_timeout(800)` after route changes in future tests.
